// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/external-tools: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_NATIVE_ID_PATTERN: RegExp;

export declare const EXTERNAL_TOOLS: readonly ExternalToolRow[];

export type ExternalSessionCapability = "discover" | "list" | "read" | "search" | "resume" | "send" | "stop" | "export";

export type ExternalToolAccess = {
    via: "command";
    argv: readonly string[];
    output: "json" | "jsonl" | "text" | "interactive";
    trust: ExternalToolReachedTrust;
} | {
    via: "protocol";
    protocol: string;
    method: string;
    trust: ExternalToolReachedTrust;
} | {
    via: "service";
    service_id: string;
    trust: ExternalToolReachedTrust;
} | {
    via: "local_record";
    root: ExternalToolPath;
    format: "documented" | "internal";
    trust: ExternalToolReachedTrust;
} | {
    via: "gap";
    gap: ExternalToolGap;
    note: string;
    fallback: "return_to_tool" | "export" | "none";
    trust: ExternalToolTrust;
};

export interface ExternalToolEntry {
    id: string;
    display_name: string;
    display_name_en?: string;
    vendor: string;
    surface: ExternalToolSurface;
    region: ExternalToolRegion;
    shares_sessions_with?: string;
    detect?: {
        commands: readonly string[];
        real_path_pattern?: string;
        version_argv: readonly string[];
        version_pattern: string;
    };
    data_root?: ExternalToolPath | null;
    mcp_integration?: true;
    terminal?: {
        command: string;
    };
    character_import?: {
        config_root: ExternalToolPath;
    };
    sessions: Readonly<Record<ExternalSessionCapability, ExternalToolAccess>>;
    checked: {
        on: string;
        version?: string;
    };
}

export type ExternalToolGap = "not_offered" | "private_store" | "interactive_only" | "needs_account" | "unverified";

export type ExternalToolId = "codex" | "claude-code" | "cursor" | "opencode" | "pi-agent" | "grok-build" | "codex-ide" | "codex-desktop" | "codex-cloud" | "claude-code-desktop" | "claude-code-ide" | "claude-code-web" | "gemini-cli" | "antigravity-cli" | "antigravity-desktop" | "copilot-cli" | "copilot-ide" | "copilot-coding-agent" | "cursor-editor" | "cursor-cloud" | "kiro-cli" | "kiro-ide" | "devin-cloud" | "devin-desktop" | "windsurf-cascade" | "junie-cli" | "junie-ide" | "droid" | "amp" | "amp-web" | "qwen-code" | "lingma" | "qoder" | "qoder-ide" | "qoder-cn" | "qoder-cn-ide" | "codebuddy" | "codebuddy-cn" | "codebuddy-ide" | "trae" | "trae-cn" | "solo" | "solo-cn" | "kimi-code" | "zcode" | "minimax-code" | "minimax-agent" | "comate" | "zulu" | "codearts-agent";

export interface ExternalToolPath {
    base: "home" | "xdg_config";
    segments: readonly string[];
    env?: string;
}

export type ExternalToolReachedTrust = "official" | "help" | "repository";

export type ExternalToolRegion = "global" | "cn" | "unspecified";

export type ExternalToolRow<Id extends ExternalToolId = ExternalToolId> = ExternalToolEntry & {
    id: Id;
} & {
    [Field in ExternalToolField as [Id] extends [ExternalToolIdsByField[Field]] ? Field : never]-?: NonNullable<ExternalToolEntry[Field]>;
} & ([Id] extends [ExternalToolIdsByField["terminal"]] ? ResumedByCommand : unknown);

export type ExternalToolSurface = "cli" | "ide" | "desktop" | "cloud";

export type ExternalToolTrust = "official" | "help" | "repository" | "third_party" | "unverified";

export type ExternalToolWith<Key extends string> = ExternalToolRow<Key extends ExternalToolField ? ExternalToolIdsByField[Key] : never>;

export declare function externalTool<Id extends ExternalToolId>(id: Id): ExternalToolRow<Id>;

export declare const externalToolIdsWith: <Key extends ExternalToolField>(key: Key) => readonly ExternalToolIdsByField[Key][];

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

type ExternalToolField = keyof ExternalToolIdsByField;

interface ExternalToolIdsByField {
    detect: "codex" | "claude-code" | "cursor" | "opencode" | "grok-build" | "gemini-cli" | "copilot-cli" | "copilot-coding-agent" | "kiro-cli" | "droid" | "amp" | "qwen-code" | "qoder" | "qoder-cn" | "codebuddy" | "kimi-code" | "minimax-code";
    terminal: "codex" | "claude-code" | "opencode" | "pi-agent" | "grok-build";
    character_import: "codex" | "claude-code" | "cursor" | "opencode" | "grok-build";
    mcp_integration: "codex" | "claude-code" | "opencode" | "pi-agent" | "grok-build";
}

type ResumedByCommand = {
    sessions: {
        resume: Extract<ExternalToolAccess, {
            via: "command";
        }>;
    };
};
